ns2:course.label: Neurobiology of Vision
ns2:course.description: Topics include physiological optics, the retina, cerebral cortex, effects of early visual experience on eye and brain development, and neural control of eye movements. Emphasis will be on aspects of vision for which direct links can be drawn between psychology and neurobiology, such as color vision, motion perceptions and depth perception. Same as NEUR 412. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PSYC 210, or an introductory course in neurobiology, or consent of instructor. Students should have knowledge of the overall structure of the brain and how neurons communicate.
